visual_action: The video shows a screenshot of a tweet from an account called "FactPost". The tweet claims that "Proposition 50 has passed in California, allowing for a new congressional map to be drawn ahead of the midterm elections." The tweet includes an image of politician Gavin Newsom at a podium with a sign reading "ELECTION RIGGING RESPONSE ACT", next to an "I Voted" sticker. The video then shows a still, full-screen image of Newsom at the podium.

intended_effect: To create a sense of victory and pride among supporters, suggesting that Democrats are successfully combating unfair electoral practices.
